card.name: A few dissenters against prevailing view
card.fires_on: Words in a sentence that introduces a small minority going against a mainstream view, such as "a few lone voices", "some researchers now", or "there are exceptions". It fires on the group noun or the word just before it.

modes.label: Few dissenting voices
modes.description: Words like lone, voices, few or exceptions that introduce a small group opposing the majority.

modes.description: Words after "fortunately" or "thankfully" saying more people or researchers are now taking a different stance.
